critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in /app/backend/routers/plays.py: pre_board_read_pack was calling call_llm(tenant_id=..., user_prompt=..., session_context=...) but call_llm() signature is (module, user_query, ..., response_format) — old call always raised TypeError caught by the except block returning 502 'AKKI couldn't read the pack just now.'. Now passes module='pre_board.read', user_query=prompt, session_context={session_id, context_id}, response_format='json'.

_spawn_auto_launched_play in /app/backend/routers/cycle.py correctly resets auto_launch_seen=False on each cron run (existing branch line 1368) — this is the desired behaviour per review request: a re-spawned cycle should re-surface a fresh PLAY READY card.
PRE_BOARD_PLAY definition has 5 stages with correct keys [arrival, reading, standouts, questions, walking_in] and editorial transition phrases, no progress-app vocabulary.

rca of the issue: Pre-Board /read 502: call_llm() signature mismatch — code in plays.py used tenant_id/user_prompt kwargs, real signature is module/user_query. except block masked the TypeError as a 502. Fixed by aligning kwargs with llm_service.call_llm(module='pre_board.read', user_query=prompt, session_context={'session_id', 'context_id'}, response_format='json').
